line: Markets show extreme fear and ETF selling pressure as Binance resumes withdrawals and Russia clears retail Bitcoin trading.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin -3.63% on the day, spot ETF net -389.0M USD (Nov 27, 2026), Fear & Greed 10 (extreme fear), funding +0.0065% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Binance lifts withdrawal suspension four weeks after $6.3 billion hack, restoring access across all networks.
Russia's VTB bank begins retail Bitcoin trading after Bank of Russia approves mandatory knowledge test for crypto buyers.
Brazil's B3 stock exchange and major banks plan real-backed stablecoin (Open BRL) for Q1 2027, one-to-one reais collateral.
